original:
Let $\Sigma$ be a signed cycle $C_{n}$ with $n\geq 3$ .
If the number of negative edges is even, then $\Sigma$ is balanced.
If it is odd, then $\Sigma$ can be switched to a signed cycle with exactly one negative edge.
By splitting one of its endpoints, we obtain $C_{n+1}$ . Therefore, the formula for ordinary cycles and (2.5) provide

 $Z_{\Sigma}(q)=\begin{cases}(q-1)^{n}+(-1)^{n}(q-1),&\text{if $\Sigma$ is balanced},\\
(q-1)^{n}-(-1)^{n},&\text{if $\Sigma$ is unbalanced}.\end{cases}$
